sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Welcome to the Health Association.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: My name is Julia.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Hi, I'm just calling to schedule a consultation with one of your online doctors for a chronic condition that I have.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: We can do that.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Do you have an account with us already?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I do not.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, so then you'll need to go to our website and create an account.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And from there, I can help you schedule a consultation, or we can do that, or you can do that yourself online.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I would be able to do this over the phone.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I'm not very comfortable with working with things online.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yep, that is totally fine.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Are you familiar with how to create an account?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, I think actually my son just helped me create it, so we should be good to go to schedule the appointment.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Can you tell me the username associated with your account, please?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, it's O -W -E -N -H -E -L -T -H.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, just to confirm, that is O -N -H -E -L -T -H.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And can you confirm your date of birth, please?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And your health card number, please?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: AB 372949HH -ON.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, perfect.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: That is a match.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, yes, you'd like to schedule a consultation.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: What type of doctor are you looking for?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Dermatologist.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: A dermatologist.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And when would you like this appointment?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Would you be able to have any availability this week or I guess next week since it's Friday?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Absolutely.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, we're mostly first -come, first -serve.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, what that means is you will submit your request for a consultation, and as a doctor becomes available, you will wait in the queue, and then the doctor will arrive and ask you a bunch of questions.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And how long will I have to wait in the queue?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: That varies, but we're generally very quick.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Less than 20 minutes is how we work.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: If it ends up being more than that, then we will have them reach out to you personally afterwards.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay, because my friend recommended me to your service, and they've been speaking with Dr. Bramson, and so I just wanted to see if I would be able to also request him directly instead of having to get a random doctor assigned to me.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yeah, his next appointment availability will be on Wednesday at 2 .30.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, that should work.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Then I will book you in.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Would I be able to send you a confirmation at that same email address that you provided me?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Or rather, okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, you can.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yes, yes.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: If you just do that email, that username, but at gmail .com, you can send it there.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, that should be arriving into your inbox shortly.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And so,

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Is there anything I need to do to prepare for this appointment or will it be fine just to show up as is?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: that is also included in your confirmation email.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: It tells you everything you need to bring to your appointment, including your health card number and some other form of identification, as well as the current medications that you're on, how long you've had the condition that you want to discuss, what the condition is, and so on.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Just like general information that will help the doctor get up to speed as quickly as possible,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: and you will be taken to a form to fill that out once you click the confirmation email.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, you'll fill out all that information that will get sent to the doctor, and they will be able to review that before your appointment, confirm those details at your appointment with you once it begins, and then your appointment commences.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And how long does the appointment usually last?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, I've booked you in for 30 minutes to start.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Would you like me to extend that to longer?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I think 30 minutes should be fine.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I just want to make sure that I'm getting seen in an appropriate amount of time because often doctors seem to be in a hurry, and then you only get five minutes out of them before you rush out the door.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yes, I understand.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: That is why we have this wonderful service here.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: We're very considerate of doctor's times, but also patient's times.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And we want to make sure that we have the appropriate length of appointments and that doctors show up at their appointment times.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Great.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And then would I also be able to get a prescription refill through you right now?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Absolutely.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Let me just go over to that section in your profile.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, and which prescription would you need to be refilled, sir?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I can't remember the name of it, but it's an antibiotic ointment that I use for my skin.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: I'm just running low, and you should be on there.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Okay, do you know the last time you refilled it?

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: It was about two months ago.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: I do see one for two months ago, approximately.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: The other ones are much older, so it is safe to assume that the two month ago one is the one that you want.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Yeah, I think I'm looking at the bottle and it says amoxicillin.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Perfect.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yeah, that checks out.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, I will trigger the refill for you, and you'll get an email of your prescription pickup that you can send to the pharmacy of your choice.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Perfect.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And then if I need to get lab tests done, obviously this is an online service, so how does that work?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, lab tests will be requisitioned for you from your doctor.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, following your consultation that you have on Wednesday, the doctor will either request or not some specific lab tests for you, and those will be sent to you electronically to print off.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And then do I just need to find a place myself to get them done or will they pick a specific place near me?

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: It will depend on the test.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, for example, for blood tests, there are usually many around in any area.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, you'll be able to locate the closest one to you and either make an appointment with them or walk in, depending on the type of clinic.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: But if it is something more like something,

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: maybe an ultrasound, that will go through us, depending on how close you are to one of our facilities.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That sounds good.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: So just to confirm, I have an appointment at 2 30 on Wednesday.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: That is correct.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And then they will let me know if I need any lab work done, and I just need to fill out the forms that are in the confirmation email.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Yes.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: And from there, from there, it will tell you how you would like to meet this doctor.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, you can do it over the phone, or you could do it over video chat, and the link to the video chat will be sent to you if you select that option.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: That sounds good to me.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Thank you for your help today.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: You're very welcome.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: And I guess I won't be seeing you, but thank you again.

sentences.speaker: CUSTOMER
sentences.text: Bye -bye.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: So, let me know if you have any more questions.

sentences.speaker: AGENT
sentences.text: Feel free to call us.
